title: Wire EDM Maximum AI Hardening — Deep Reasoning, Neural, Physics, Digital Twin

units.title: Deep Reasoning AI domains (12)
units.details: Added 12 deep reasoning domains: wedm_causal_chain (multi-level causal trees), wedm_root_cause (5 Whys, Ishikawa, FTA), wedm_what_if (scenario analysis), wedm_tradeoff_optimization (Pareto analysis), wedm_constraint_satisfaction (feasibility solver), wedm_fmea_reasoning (RPN calculation), wedm_decision_justification (explainability), wedm_alternative_analysis (decision matrix), wedm_risk_decomposition (component risks), wedm_confidence_calibration (Bayesian), wedm_analogical_reasoning (transfer), wedm_case_based (CBR)

units.title: Neural/ML AI domains (12)
units.details: Added 12 neural/ML domains: wedm_pattern_recognition (temporal, spatial, correlational), wedm_anomaly_detection (statistical, ML, physics-based), wedm_predictive_model (hybrid physics-ML), wedm_time_series_forecast (LSTM, ARIMA), wedm_transfer_learning (domain adaptation), wedm_reinforcement_optimize (RL policies), wedm_neural_architecture (MLP, CNN, LSTM, Transformer), wedm_feature_extraction (spectral, morphological), wedm_clustering_analysis (k-means, DBSCAN), wedm_regression_model (GB, GP), wedm_classification_model (RF, SVM), wedm_ensemble_prediction (stacking, boosting)

units.title: Physics-Informed AI domains (12)
units.details: Added 12 physics-informed domains: wedm_thermal_validation (model vs. measured), wedm_recast_prediction (physics-ML hybrid), wedm_wire_deflection (catenary model), wedm_spark_gap_model (Paschen), wedm_crater_formation (DiBitonto), wedm_melt_pool_dynamics (Marangoni), wedm_debris_evacuation (CFD), wedm_dielectric_breakdown (ionization), wedm_energy_partition (anode/cathode/dielectric), wedm_plasma_channel (temperature, pressure), wedm_surface_tension (melt behavior), wedm_resolidification (microstructure)

units.title: Digital Twin AI domains (8)
units.details: Added 8 digital twin domains: wedm_twin_sync (OPC-UA, MTConnect), wedm_realtime_update (online learning), wedm_virtual_commission (simulation validation), wedm_sensor_fusion (Kalman, EKF), wedm_state_estimation (hidden states), wedm_predictive_maintenance (RUL), wedm_health_monitoring (SPC metrics), wedm_adaptive_control (self-tuning)

units.title: Expert prompts for all 44 domains
units.details: Created Claude Opus-level expert prompts for each domain with: domain expertise framing, structured methodology, relevant physics references, specific outputs expected, uncertainty quantification guidance

units.title: Tribal synthesis for all 44 domains

summary: Maximum AI hardening for Wire EDM. 44 new domains across 4 categories: Deep Reasoning (12 domains for causal analysis, FMEA, explainability), Neural/ML (12 domains for pattern recognition, prediction, optimization), Physics-Informed (12 domains for thermal/spark/melt modeling), Digital Twin (8 domains for sync, PdM, adaptive control). All domains have expert prompts, tribal synthesis, AND full orchestration integration. 96 tests passing (48 domain + 48 integration). Total WEDM AI domains: 106. Total WEDM AI tests: 217.
